programme.desc: Kimball and Dangle escort the Prefect of Wanganui, Reno's sister city, around town; Junior and Wiegel struggle to stand out at the high school job fair.

programme.title: The Roast of Bruce Willis
programme.desc: Roast Master Joseph Gordon-Levitt og et panel med Edward Norton, Nikki Glaser, Lil Rel Howery, Jeff Ross og flere tilbringer aftenen med sætte actionlegenden Bruce Willis på plads.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Ondskabens Kirkegard 2
programme.desc: Da områdets børn støder Jeff ud, bliver han ven med en anden outsider, Drew Gilbert, som lever i frygt for sin onde stedfar Gus. Efter at Gus har skudt Drews elskede hund, begraver drengene hunden på et sted, der siges at kunne genoplive de døde.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Da en ny familie flytter ind i Katie og Kristis hjem, opdager de et videokamera, der afslører en oldgammel ondskab, der begynder at terrorisere dem. De må kæmpe mod den dæmoniske trussel for ikke at blive ofre i den banebrydende horror-franchise.

programme.title: Fredag den 13. - Del VIII: Jason indtager Manhattan
programme.desc: New York er i store problemer, fordi den udødelige djævel, Jason Voorhees tager på tur til New York og maler byen rød.

programme.title: Fredag den 13. - Del VIII: Jason indtager Manhattan
programme.desc: New York er i store problemer, fordi den udødelige djævel, Jason Voorhees tager på tur til New York og maler byen rød.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Shaman's Apprentice
programme.desc: The grandson of an Indian shaman, who has embraced the white man's medicine and become a doctor, is frustrated by the patients he loses. He then comes across a cursed Indian rattle.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Spirit Of Television
programme.desc: A psychic uses a cursed antique to trade her clients' lives for a temporary cure for her degenerative disease.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Faith Healer
programme.desc: Jack is asked by a friend to investigate a faith healer who uses a cursed glove to heal one person...by transferring their ills magnified tenfold to another victim.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: And Now The News
programme.desc: In an insane asylum, a doctor is using a cursed antique radio to enact miraculous cures on his patients.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Equipped with new insight into the Kentucky Anomaly and a bevy of compiled evidence of paranormal phenomena, the team returns to the Conrad-Caldwell Museum.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon investigates the Conrad-Caldwell House, a Victorian-era home that’s said to still be inhabited by some of its original owners.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with author David Domine to learn about the tragedy of Annie Whipple, a supposed “witch” who communicated with spirits to save the life of a child in her care.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Zombie-betjenten Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar, »Tango & Cash«) er tilbage fra de døde for tredje gang! Denne gang er han på udkig efter en kæreste – en sød, øm og udød. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The Gate
programme.desc: Fjernelsen af et gammelt træ i Glens baghave afslører et stort og mystisk hul, der fører til Porten - et underjordisk kammer med frygtindgydende dæmonisk ondskab.

programme.title: The Dark Horse
programme.desc: THE DARK HORSE er et følelsesladet og inspirerende drama om den bi-polare Genesis (Cliff Curtis), der søger efter modet til lede, på trods af hans egne udfordringer. Han spiller lynskak, og sætter sig for at træne de unge i kvarteret, for at holde dem…

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Hayden Christensen spiller hovedrollen i denne anmelderroste sande historie om en vanæret journalist, instrueret og medforfattet af Billy Ray, Oscar®-nomineret forfatter til CAPTAIN PHILLIPS.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: Jake goes to prison to protect his friends and his best friend Chris turns his life around to become a police officer. When Jake is released after 15 years, he seeks revenge.

programme.title: See No Evil 2
programme.desc: Amys venner overrasker hende på hendes fødselsdag, men overraskelsen er over dem, da liget af Jacob Goodnight vender tilbage for at genoptage hans morderiske hærværk.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: En revisor fra skattevæsenet bliver pludselig genstand for en fortælling, som kun han selv kan høre: en fortælling, der begynder at påvirke hele hans liv, fra hans arbejde til hans kærlighed til hans død.

programme.title: Familien Bélier
programme.desc: 16-årige Paula er tolk for sine døvstumme forældre og bror på daglig basis, specielt når det gælder driften af familiens landbrug. Da Paulas musiklærer opdager den unge piges helt særlige talent for at synge, opfordrer han hende straks til at melde sig...

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: Himlen over Wenders krigshærgede Berlin er fyldt med engle i trench-coats, der usynligt bevæger sig rundt blandt menneskene og lytter til deres fortvivlede tanker og prøver at støtte dem.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: Byen Stepford har en hemmelighed. Alle hustruerne er alt for perfekte og alle mændene er alt for lykkelige. Denne komiske thriller er en genindspilning af den spændende klassiker fra 1975. Velkommen til Stepford- den amerikanske drøm.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson er tilbage som den tidligere CIA-agent Bryan Mills, der er ved at blive forsonet med sin ekskone, da hun bliver brutalt myrdet. Mills bliver beskyldt for mordet og tager flugten optændt af raseri og med CIA, FBI og politiet i hælene.

programme.title: The Con is On
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at slippe for at betale en gigantisk spillegæld, flygter Harriet og Peter til Hollywood. Planen er, at infiltrere et juvelrøveri som involverer Peters eks-kone.

programme.title: Mutant X: tid i anden kvadrat
programme.desc: Ashlocke går tilbage i tiden for at forsøge at gøre sig selv uovervindelig ved at give noget til at sidde yngre jeg, hvilket får Brennan og Shalimar til at følge efter ham.

programme.title: Mutant X: hvis skove er disse
programme.desc: Holdet begiver sig ud i vildmarken for at opspore et dræbende dyr, der har vandrere som mål.

programme.title: Mutant X: fremtiden afsløret

programme.title: Mutant X: ingen mand efterladt
programme.desc: Et militærfly bliver skudt ned bag fjendens linjer, hvilket får holdet til at gøre et desperat forsøg på at finde det hemmelige regeringsvåben, der er gemt om bord.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert
programme.desc: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Best of Special

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Keisha Knight Pulliam, Ming-Na, Chi McBride, Mia Tyler
programme.desc: Keisha Knight Pulliam encounters a lingering family spirit; while making renovations on her new house, Ming-Na discovers a previous owner is reluctant to leave.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Brett Butler, Cassandra Peterson, Phil Varone, Ana Gasteyer
programme.desc: A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: En ung idealistisk advokat tager en sag om en fattig familie, hvis søn bliver nægtet hjælp af et stort forsikringsselskab og dør, og afslører forsikringssvindel for milliarder af dollar.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: Delirious
programme.desc: When a soap opera writer bumps his head and wakes up in the midst of his own daytime serial, he writes himself into the storyline of a lifetime!

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Prince

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlægger finder kærligheden, da hun arbejder med at arrange det sidste bryllup på et historisk værtshus.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Minder fra Montmartre

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sæt tilbage

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Legenden om de fortabte

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The Haunting of...: T-Pain
programme.desc: Music Mogul and rapper T-Pain seeks psychic medium Kim Russo's help in uncovering what is causing the terrifying paranormal activity in his family's home in Roswell, Georgia.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Karina Smirnoff
programme.desc: Psychic Medium Kim Russo helps Dancing With The Stars Karina Smirnoff confront the ghosts who are terrorizing her family in their Woodland Hills, California home.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Vores livs ferie
programme.desc: Oplev de to Oscarvindere, Helen Mirren og Donald Sutherland, i en forrygende og moden roadmovie, der både leverer gode grin og stof til eftertanke.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Den midaldrende husmor Terrys liv bliver vendt på hovedet, da hendes mand pludselig flytter til Sverige med sin sekretær. Snart begynder Terry at føle sig tiltrukket af mandens bedste ven, den tidligere baseballstjerne Denny.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: The Golden Child

programme.title: Pas på, politiet kommer
programme.desc: Slagsbrødrene Wilbur Walsh (Bud Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Terence Hill) slår pjalterne sammen og planlægger at røve et supermarked, men planen går så skævt, at de to småforbrydere i stedet ender med at melde sig ind i politikorpset!

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent fra Abyss forsøger at lokke Harper til at slutte sig til Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: Da de redder en ung prins fra et oprør, der dræber resten af hans familie, bliver Dylan og Tyr bedt om at blive hans rådgivere.

programme.title: Mutant X: sjælens korsvej
programme.desc: Holdet tager af sted for at redde Brennan, der er blevet fanget i en usynlig by og står over for at blive henrettet for en forbrydelse, han ikke har begået.

programme.title: Mutant X: tegn fra oven

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.desc: Gene kommer hjem fra sin ekskones begravelse. Kort etter blir datteren hans kidnappet. Han får en pistol og beskjed om at om han ikke har drept den personen om 1 time og 15 minutter, blir datteren hans drept.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: Tre generasjoner med legendariske komikere spiller i denne historien om nattblubbeieren Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) og sønnen hans Quick (Eddie Murphy), som kjemper for å hindre en ondskapsfull gangster og en korrupt politistyrke i å stenge klubben.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: Wesley Snipes faller ut i fallskjermhoppernes verden i jakten på en gjeng teknoterrorister i Drop Zone, med Gary Busey, Yancy Butler, Michael Jeter og flere.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: En tidligere fange tar en jobb som langdistansesjåfør for en lastebil. Lastebilen er imidlertid fylt med våpen, og han må kjempe for å redde familien sin og overleve.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden rakner når to lekre menn plutselig dukker opp: en sexy, ny klassekamerat og den søte eks-stebroren hennes. Nå oppdager hun at når det kommer til kjærlighet, er hun totalt uvitende.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: The American Friend aka Der Amerikanische Freund
programme.desc: The American Friend er i dag en kultfilm, basert på romanen “Ripley’s Game” av Patricia Highsmith og vinner av den tyske kritikerprisen i 1977. Rammemakeren Jonathan (Bruno Ganz) tror han er i ferd med å dø av en blodsykdom.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhet innrammet
programme.desc: Mannskapet må stjele en juvel som er i sentrum av en strid mellom en driftseier og Than. Beka faller for en sikkerhetssjef som tidligere var en tyv.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pitiless as the Sun

programme.desc: is using a mirror that he prepared before his death, hidden away in an old home that the cousins were unaware their uncle owned. The mirror will open a doorway to hell and let Lewis escape.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Vanessa Williams

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.title: Body Parts
programme.desc: Når Bill Chrashank mister armen i en bilulykke, blir armen til en henrettet dødsdømt transplantert på i stedet. Det eneste problemet, som Bill snart oppdager, er at armen er besatt av en kraft han ikke kan kontrollere.

programme.title: Troll 2
programme.desc: Trolls live in the woods around Nibog and feed on the town's population. By transforming themselves into people, the trolls are able to come into town and pick their menu.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Savannens Herskere
programme.desc: Michael Douglas og Val Kilmer spiller i dette eventyret lagt til Øst-Afrika i 1896. Byggingen av jernbanen er stanset av to menneskeetende løver som jakter sammen uten frykt for mennesker eller ild.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars er en elskverdig introvert mann med emosjonell bagasje som har hindret ham i å si ja til livet. Etter år av ensomhet inviterer han Bianca, en venn han har møtt på Internett, til å møte ham. Han introduserer Bianca for sin bror og hans kone...

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: En mann leter etter sin savnede kone etter at bilen hans konker midt i ørkenen.

programme.title: AWOL-72

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tenåringene Eddie og Amber vokste opp i en liten irsk småby på 1990-tallet. Alle mistenker at de er homofile, og hver dag er en kamp. De kommer sammen på late som og innser at et imaginært forhold kan være minst like komplisert som et ekte

programme.title: The Vows We Keep

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Osbourne, Ahmad Rashad, Mia Tyler, Renee Taylor
programme.desc: Joan Osborne is attacked by the ghost of a woman with a painful history.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Dyan Cannon, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Quinton Aaron, Bridget Marquardt
programme.desc: A young Dyan Cannon is visited in the night by a guardian spirit. Wendi McLendon-Covey has a paranormal encounter after a walk through a cemetery. Quinton Aaron encounters.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Florida Project
programme.desc: Seks år gamle Moonee og hennes mor som bor på et budsjettmotell utenfor Disney World i Florida.

programme.title: Howard Stern'S Edle Deler
programme.desc: Edle Deler følger Howard Sterns fantastiske transformasjon fra skolenerd til mediesuperstjerne.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: Tully er regissert av Jason Reitman og manuset skrevet av Diablo Cody, duoen som tidligere har laget Juno og Young Adults.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Bryan Mills og hans kone er i Istanbul når de blir bortført. Mannen som holder dem som gissel viser seg å være far til en av de mennene som tidligere kidnappet Mills datter, og under frigjøringen av datteren ble han drept.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Mens Tim drømte om å jobbe i justisdepartementet, ønsket Peter å bli en sterk politisk aktør - for enhver pris.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: En gruppe engler i den tyske hovedstaden ser med lengsel på menneskers liv.

programme.title: Mutant X: No Man Left Behind
programme.desc: Et militærfly blir skutt ned bak fiendens linjer, og får laget til å gjøre et desperat bud på å gjenopprette det hemmelige regjeringsvåpenet som er skjult om bord.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Dagger of Death
programme.desc: India, 500 e.Kr.: En dyrebar dolk brukes i menneskelige ofre til gudinnen Kali. Sydney må returnere en relikvie til India for sin medjeger, som tror at dolken fikk ham til å drepe assistenten.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: På jakt etter et søramerikansk Mochica-indisk beskyttelsesrester, blir Nigel og hans kolleger fanget av lokale geriljaer. Det er opp til Sydney og alliert Jason Clark å redde dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney gjenforenes med kjæresten på videregående skole for å spore et hawaiisk fruktbarhetsidol på Madagaskar.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney mottar et kort sjeldne Tarot-kort fra sin nylig avdøde venn. Den beryktede, tidligere nevnte Gribben var etter ham. Sydney verver Claudia til å hjelpe.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Lewis Black, Meshach Taylor, Samantha Harris
programme.desc: Lewis takes a summer job in the Michigan woods and is visited by unseen entities who torment him at night; Meshach is visited by the ghost of an evil child predator.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Feast And The Girl Under The Bridge
programme.desc: A bachelorette party at a rustic cabin in the mountains goes horribly wrong. A woman searches for the identity of her young son's elusive "friend".

programme.title: My Haunted House: Sad Sam and Black Magic
programme.desc: A clown stays in a family's home long after the birthday party is over. A woman believes local Santeria practitioners put a curse on her when she moves into a traditional Miami neighborhood.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Sympathy and The Engagement
programme.desc: A couple is mysteriously poisoned on their first night in a new home. A woman fears the horrifying activity in her home could be related to an antique her fiance purchased.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Hazel and House of Sacrifice
programme.desc: All hell breaks loose after a couple takes in a troubled foster child. A family struggles to come to terms with the events that happened in their basement.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: Fast Girls
programme.desc: En gatsmart sprintertjej får en bitter rival i sin minst lika ambitiösa men rikare lagkamrat i detta sexiga, kaxiga, vilda och fartfyllda drama med massor av romantik, konflikter och den nervpirrande jakten på guldet.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: Pluto TV Komedi
programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin and Jack Warden play navy buddies that made the French Polynesian island of Haleakaloha their post-war paradise. Local headquarters is Donovan's Reef, Wayne's watering hole.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: När en amerikansk stad invaderas av nordkoreanska soldater, går en grupp ungdomar tillsammans för att skydda varandra, befria staden och återta sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Eld i himlen
programme.desc: Medan Sydney föreläser om indianerna som stod inför en mystisk katastrof 600 år tidigare, ger en indian henne en relik från den tiden. Vad är dess hemlighet?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Att jaga med fienden
programme.desc: En urna som den kinesiske kejsaren beställt i ett kambodjanskt kloster för Konfucius kvarlevor är på väg att förstöras genom systematisk bombning av en hel provins.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel reser till Istanbul för att undersöka döden hos en av Sydneys vänner, en professor som försökte bevisa att Herkules existerade genom att hitta Hippolytes bälte.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Under isen
programme.desc: Trots det hemska vädret tar Sidney med sig Nigel till en arktisk bas där man har hittat en gammal indiansk mumie som visar sig vara en Anasazi.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent
programme.desc: Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Just Married…with Children

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Father Lode
programme.desc: After going with Steve to the racetrack, Al is reluctant to reveal that he won $1,200, because he knows that Peggy and the kids will take the money for themselves.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
programme.desc: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
programme.desc: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
programme.desc: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'm Going to Sweatland
programme.desc: When a perspiration stain on one of Al's shirts resembles a silhouette of The King of Rock & Roll, the Bundy household becomes a hot spot for Elvis Presley fanatics to visit.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Poke High (aka The Red Grange Story)
programme.desc: A young football player, named Matt, from Polk High where Kelly and Bud go to school is threatening two Bundy records. One held by Al for the most touchdowns in one season, and the other by Kelly for refusing her advances.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sporting goods / Cow tipping
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head decide to get athletic gear supporters for gym class / The duo venture out on a quest for cow tipping

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment
programme.desc: Beavis can't take Butt-head's verbal abuse anymore, and snaps while they're checking out the site of a local murder. / Beavis and Butt-head sue Kimberly for sexual harassment, since she's giving them wood.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Butt-Head blir snäll / Hemhjälpen
programme.desc: Butt-Head får medicin för sin aggressivitet mot Beavis och blir lite för snäll./ Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head får slut på ölpengar, så Beavis måste skaffa ett jobb.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jumping the Shark
programme.desc: Garcia breaks up Dangle's wedding in more ways than one, and Terry the prostitute finds someone to love.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Tommy Hawk
programme.desc: Tommy Hawk, bounty hunter, and reality TV star runs afoul of the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Kevlar for Her
programme.desc: The department's new bulletproof vests for women have an unexpected side effect: super knockers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Mayor Hernandez
programme.desc: Reno's Mayor Hernandez asks the Sheriff's Department for help, and the deputies must decide whether to uphold the law or uphold local government.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Coconut Nut Clusters
programme.desc: The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Back in Black
programme.desc: Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover at Burger Cousin
programme.desc: Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Wall
programme.desc: Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Death of a Pickle-Thrower
programme.desc: Jackie, the pickle-throwing hooker, spends her twilight hours with the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programme.desc: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom.
